samples.text_head: Quarterly Net Asset Value Update | Company Announcement | Investegate Fundraise Welcome Articles About Contact Us Help Home Companies Advanced search Archive Meetings UK Newswire New Login Register Quarterly Net Asset Value Update Macau Property Opportunities Fund 22 September 2026 22 September 2026 Macau Property Opportunities Fund Limited ("MPO" or the "Company") Quarterly Net Asset Value Update Macau Property Opportunities Fund Limited, managed by property investment manager Sniper Capital Limited, announces that the unaudited Adjusted Net Asset Value of the Company was US$18.9 million as at 30 June 2026. This is equivalent to US $0.31 (23 pence*) per share and represents a decline of 19.6% (19.7% in Sterling terms) from the previous quarter. The movement in the unaudited Adjusted Net Asset Value is primarily a consequence of reduced property valuations, reflecting market conditions and the increased pressure on the Company's disposal strategy due to the challenging position the Company has with its lending banks. On a like-for-like basis, the portfolio has declined 8.5% over the quarter. * Based on the US Dollar/Sterling exchange rate of 1.324 on 30 June 2026. The US Dollar/Sterling exchange rate was 1.321 as at 31 March 2026. Note: 1. The above figures are estimates only and are unaudited and derived from independently assessed valuations. No reliance should be placed upon the unaudited Adjusted Net Asset Value per share, which should only be taken as an indicative value. 2. Detailed information on the Company's portfolio and Macau market can be found on the Company's website at www.mpofund.com . 3. The content of this announcement contains inside information. About Macau Property Opportunities Fund Premium listed on the London Stock Exchange, Macau Property Opportunities Fund Limited is a closed-end investment company registered in Guernsey and is the only quoted property fund dedicated to investing in Macau, the world's leading gaming market and the only city in China where gaming is legalised. Launched in 2006, the Company targets strategic property investment and development opportunities in Macau. Its current portfolio comprises prime residential property assets. The Company is managed by Sniper Capital Limited , an Asia-based property investment manager with an established track record in fund management and investment advisory.
